data.body: **[P1] Require a core version that enforces this group.** The OTel package still permits `aws-durable-execution-sdk-python>=2.0.0`, but existing 2.0.x releases do not validate `exclusive_group`. On those allowed installations this metadata is ignored and both views still load, so upgrading only OTel leaves the reported bug unfixed. Raise the OTel package's minimum core dependency to the first release containing this validation and update its metadata tests, or enforce the conflict within OTel itself.
